name: mymemory
description: Router skill for the MyMemory package. MyMemory turns a folder of Markdown into a searchable, linked knowledge graph: hybrid retrieval (BM25 exact terms + semantic vectors + graph traversal), Obsidian wikilinks and tags, a CLI (mem) and an MCP server exposing 20 tools. This package is split by capability into six focused skills - mymemory-cli, mymemory-mcp, mymemory-notes, mymemory-graph, mymemory-config and mymemory-knowledge-base - so an agent loads only the one that answers the task. Load the router when you need to find the right skill, or when you need the cross-cutting model: a note is only reachable if it is indexed, linked and described.

skills.name: mymemory-cli
skills.summary: Running the mem CLI from a shell or script.

skills.name: mymemory-mcp
skills.summary: Wiring an MCP client and choosing between the 20 tools and the CLI.

skills.name: mymemory-notes
skills.summary: Authoring notes: frontmatter taxonomy, wikilinks, typed edges, tags.

skills.name: mymemory-graph
skills.summary: Graph queries and vault health: inspect, path, hubs, clusters, impact, drift, doctor.

skills.name: mymemory-config
skills.summary: Config precedence, the global/local storage split, SQLite vs Postgres, central vault.

skills.name: mymemory-knowledge-base
skills.summary: Building a base of knowledge from many sources, with verified provenance.

related.note: Generic Obsidian syntax lives in the obsidian-skills package (obsidian-markdown, json-canvas, obsidian-bases). This package only covers what is specific to a MyMemory index and note graph.
